title: Type system — quick overview
rememberThis: `var` infers a static type at compile time — it is not JavaScript `var` and not `dynamic`.
Use `decimal` (with `m`) for money and grades; use `double` for graphics and science.
Value types copy on assignment; reference types alias the same object. Boxing wraps a value as `object`.
`int?` is `Nullable<int>` — a struct for missing numbers. `string?` is still a reference type (full story in module 07).
bullets: Locals need definite assignment before read; fields and array slots default to zero or null.
`typeof` is compile-time; `GetType()` is run-time; `is`/`as` test type compatibility.
Custom kinds: class, struct, record, interface, enum, tuple, generic — pick by identity vs copyable data.
Every type connects to `object` through the Common Type System (CTS). Prefer typed DTOs over `dynamic`.
Stack versus heap and Garbage Collector (GC) details: see module 14.
